periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt from the posterior edge toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering at the inferior-anterior quadrant, resulting in a teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 30% of the visible longitudinal torso span at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately 1.2x the lateral width of a single ear region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast boundary where the black pigmentation of the hind limbs meets the white fur of the pelvic region, extending high toward the dorsal spine.
